description: Z-machine adventures and an optional online library for Cardputer Zero

store.summary: Play Z-machine adventures with saves, readable text and an online library.
store.description: A graphical Frotz frontend for v3-v8 Z-machine adventures on Cardputer Zero. Home shows Continue with the last played title, Library, Downloads, Settings, Help and Exit. Story pages offer covers, summaries, play/save actions and confirmed deletion that keeps saved games and shared media. All four arrows and visible number shortcuts navigate menus. Ctrl+V offers Reader, Fit Screen, Fill Screen, Fit Width, Actual Pixels, Reading Zoom, Frame + Text Zoom and Automatic. Ctrl+U/D changes size; Ctrl+P/N recalls commands. Reader includes untimed opening title pauses and keeps your place during resizing. Automatic is the default for every supported V3-V8 story. It wraps text at the chosen size, including timed prompts; Tab shows the original artwork, maps and status without advancing the game. Existing stories switch once, and later manual choices persist. Continue retains the readable page and text/original-view selection. Framed zoom fills the screen with a V6 border while enlarging its main text window at untimed command prompts; original wide lines may need panning. Download selected stories from the Infocom catalogue or IF Archive, including supported ZIP bundles. Notes are cached offline; manual links have QR codes. Includes named-save Load, Rename and confirmed Delete with automatic Continue protected, Quetzal saves, history, scrollback, mute/volume, dark/light themes, offline credits and Continue at supported untimed v3-v5/v7/v8 prompts. V6 automatic resume is unavailable; use story SAVE/RESTORE. No commercial stories or covers are included. Screenshots use original CC0 fixtures.
